assets.name: bow-and-oval-chain-cycle
assets.description: Original printed bow and oval chain cycle, with transparent paper and source-derived repeat corners. Part of the Schön Neues Modelbuch (Page 4 recto) (met-680623) set.

extraction.method: Native-resolution continuous ink coverage after locally measured paper removal; PNG appearance master.
extraction.source_rgb_modified: Paper removed by measured ink coverage; RGB is the scan-measured ink tone, not an exact source-pixel crop.

join_adjustment.method: average matching source collars; interior columns 2 through width-3 unchanged
join_adjustment.source_cycle_verification: Complete original horizontal bow-plus-oval block repeated in multiple adjacent top-band cells; the asterisk interruption at the left and damaged outer terminals are excluded. Both oval and bow loops are retained.

repeat_build.corner_method: Mitered reflections of the exact same native unit, using the repository’s four phase-matched corner geometry. Derived corners are distinct from the original fixed printer-frame corners.

review.notes: Complete original motif periods inspected before local native phase matching. Source ink and continuous alpha retained, all interior columns unchanged; only documented two-pixel matching collars averaged. Five-cycle strips and all four phase-derived miter corners inspected on white/dark; fixed frame keeps actual varied bands/corners. Cleaner bow impression chosen after four originals compared, no paper-fold blot repeated. Rotated units and bars are exact native 90-degree turns. No faceted trace.
